summary: Provides farmers with timely access to short-term credit for cultivation and allied needs at concessional interest rates.
benefits: Short-term credit limit for crop production, post-harvest expenses, and allied activities with interest subvention.
eligibility: Farmers, tenant farmers, oral lessees and sharecroppers
Members of SHGs/JLGs engaged in farming
application_steps: Apply at any participating bank branch or via the PM-KISAN portal KCC link
